pages.text: The oven has a single slot that holds up to $(item)64$() items of one kind. Every block of the square leads to the controller's slot, so you can insert from any face of any oven block.

$(li)Use a $(item)funnel$(), a $(item)chute$(), a hopper or a belt ending in a funnel to push coal or logs in.$(li)The slot is $(item)insert only$(): a hopper under the oven can no longer pull the coal back out.

$(l)Collecting the coke$()$(br)When an item is done, the result is $(item)dropped as an item$() just in front of the $(item)controller$() (the bottom front block), with a small push forward. The doors swing open near the end of each cycle.

Leave that space free and catch the drops: a belt running across the front, or a hopper or funnel set right in front of the controller, works well. Send the coke to a crushing wheel or millstone to make $(item)coal coke dust$() for the blast furnace.
